$comment: Chrona operational failure boundaries. Expected outcomes (an invalid label, a storage failure the kernel reports, a stale storage result) remain typed engine outcomes shown as ordinary page content and are not Aegis faults. See src/Chrona.Application/Boundary.fs.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (kernel verification slice)
boundaries.$comment: Every kernel message is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (Wire.handle). A message that is not the Limen shape the engine relies on (including an unsupported protocol version) is MESSAGE_INVALID; a kernel without the Storage effect, or a result or fact for something the engine never requested or negotiated, is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Programming defects (an event name index.html sends that the engine does not know) keep Aegis fail-loud semantics and surface as a Limen bridge error.

boundaries.name: Browser localStorage
boundaries.$comment: The kernel performs the Storage effects the engine requests. Their outcomes (including unavailable and quota-exceeded) cross the Limen protocol as explicit typed StorageResults; this declaration does not pretend the .NET Aegis runtime guards JavaScript localStorage.

persistence.fallbackBehaviour: Aegis sink failures are contained by the configured fallback; Chrona does not treat diagnostic persistence as business success.
persistence.retentionPolicy: No durable Aegis sink is configured; in the browser the standard-error sink writes to the console.
